fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_1[0]
fields.speak: Page 1. Name(s) shown on return.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_2[0]
fields.speak: Your social security number.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_3[0]
fields.speak: Part I. Additional Medicare Tax on Medicare Wages. 1. Medicare wages and tips from Form W-2, box 5. If you have more than one Form W-2, enter the total of the amounts from box 5.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_4[0]
fields.speak: 2. Unreported tips from Form 4137, line 6.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_5[0]
fields.speak: 3. Wages from Form 8919, line 6.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_6[0]
fields.speak: 4. Add lines 1 through 3.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_7[0]
fields.speak: 5. Enter the following amount for your filing status: Married filing jointly, $250,000. Married filing separately, $125,000. Single, Head of household, or Qualifying surviving spouse, $200,000.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_8[0]
fields.speak: 6. Subtract line 5 from line 4. If zero or less, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_9[0]
fields.speak: 7. Additional Medicare Tax on Medicare wages. Multiply line 6 by 0.9% (0.009). Enter here and go to Part I I.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_10[0]
fields.speak: Part I I. Additional Medicare Tax on Self-Employment Income. 8. Self-employment income from Schedule S E (Form 1040), Part I, line 6. If you had a loss, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_11[0]
fields.speak: 9. Enter the following amount for your filing status: Married filing jointly, $250,000. Married filing separately, $125,000. Single, Head of household, or Qualifying surviving spouse, $200,000.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_12[0]
fields.speak: 10. Enter the amount from line 4.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_13[0]
fields.speak: 11. Subtract line 10 from line 9. If zero or less, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_14[0]
fields.speak: 12. Subtract line 11 from line 8. If zero or less, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_15[0]
fields.speak: 13. Additional Medicare Tax on self-employment income. Multiply line 12 by 0.9% (0.009). Enter here and go to Part I I I.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_16[0]
fields.speak: Part I I I. Additional Medicare Tax on Railroad Retirement Tax Act (R R T A) Compensation. 14. Railroad retirement (R R T A) compensation and tips from Form(s) W-2, box 14 (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_17[0]
fields.speak: 15. Enter the following amount for your filing status: Married filing jointly, $250,000. Married filing separately, $125,000. Single, Head of household, or Qualifying surviving spouse, $200,000.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_18[0]
fields.speak: 16. Subtract line 15 from line 14. If zero or less, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_19[0]
fields.speak: 17. Additional Medicare Tax on railroad retirement (R R T A) compensation. Multiply line 16 by 0.9% (0.009). Enter here and go to Part I V.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_20[0]
fields.speak: Part I V. Total Additional Medicare Tax. 18. Add lines 7, 13, and 17. Also include this amount on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 11 (Form 1040-S S filers, see instructions), and go to Part V.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_21[0]
fields.speak: Part V. Withholding Reconciliation. 19. Medicare tax withheld from Form W-2, box 6. If you have more than one Form W-2, enter the total of the amounts from box 6.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_22[0]
fields.speak: 20. Enter the amount from line 1.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_23[0]
fields.speak: 21. Multiply line 20 by 1.45% (0.0145). This is your regular Medicare tax withholding on Medicare wages.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_24[0]
fields.speak: 22. Subtract line 21 from line 19. If zero or less, enter 0. This is your Additional Medicare Tax withholding on Medicare wages.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_25[0]
fields.speak: 23. Additional Medicare Tax withholding on railroad retirement (R R T A) compensation from Form W-2, box 14 (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_26[0]
fields.speak: 24. Total Additional Medicare Tax withholding. Add lines 22 and 23. Also include this amount with federal income tax withholding on Form 1040, 1040-S R, or 1040-N R, line 25c (Form 1040-S S filers, see instructions).
